blocks.title: Design with the whole Cloudflare platform in view
blocks.description: Give Vetta the platform map and decision rules it needs to choose suitable Cloudflare services, configuration and deployment paths.

showcase.user_prompt: Design a Cloudflare architecture for a global API with durable state, object storage and private origin access.
showcase.assistant_reply: I’ll separate compute, state, storage and network access, verify current Cloudflare contracts, and explain the operational tradeoffs before changing any resources.

blocks.title: Use the right service for the job

items.title: Choose the architecture
items.description: Compare Workers, Durable Objects, KV, D1, R2 and networking products using current platform constraints.

items.title: Keep configuration coherent
items.description: Connect bindings, secrets, compatibility settings and deployment environments without duplicating sources of truth.

items.title: Retrieve before relying
items.description: Check live Cloudflare documentation for APIs, limits and pricing that can change over time.

items.title: Describe the outcome
items.description: Explain what you are building, your traffic, data and security needs, and any existing Cloudflare resources.

items.title: Review the proposal
items.description: Ask Vetta to compare alternatives and verify changing limits or API contracts before implementation.

items.title: Choose when to act
items.description: Use the separate documentation and account connections only when the task needs live information or resource changes.

blocks.title: Guidance, not account access
blocks.content: This package supplies platform guidance only. Install the optional Cloudflare Documentation or Cloudflare API connection when you want live documentation or account operations.
